name: Ren "Offgrid" Tanaka

power.name: System Sight
power.description: Sees the shape of a problem before the problem finishes forming. Builds in silence for months. Returns with something finished.

tagline: Went quiet in March. Came back in September with a working prototype.
backstory: Ren does not post. Ren does not update. Ren disappears for months and people assume he has quit. He has not quit. He is ten thousand words deep in a document no one has seen and a repository no one has access to. When he surfaces, it works. It has always worked. He is deeply suspicious of anyone who needs to announce what they are doing.

rival.name: The Loud Announcer
rival.description: Posts daily. Ships monthly. Everything is a launch. Ren has watched him for three years with the patience of a glacier.

mentor.name: The Absent Senior
mentor.description: Taught Ren once, briefly, by email. Has not been heard from in four years. Ren is trying to reach the bar that email set.

final_form_locked: Final Form: The Finished Thing — unlocks after Episode 5.
opening_line: He did not announce that he was building. He did not announce when he was done. He let the work do it.
